products.name: Malabar Tellicherry Black Pepper (Garbled)
products.shortDescription: Bold 4.5mm sun-dried black peppercorns from Idukki, renowned for sharp heat and citrus-woody undertones.
products.description: Grown in high-altitude shade plantations in Kerala, our Malabar black pepper is harvested at optimal maturity and sun-cured naturally on bamboo mats. Rich in natural piperine, it delivers an instant floral burst followed by a sustained, complex peppery heat.
ingredients: 100% Pure Garbled Whole Black Peppercorns (Piper nigrum)
products.storageInfo: Store in an airtight ceramic or glass jar in a cool, dark cupboard away from direct sunlight and humidity.
products.usageTips: Crack coarsely right before serving over creamy gravies, roasted meats, pasta, or traditional rasam.

products.name: Alleppey Green Cardamom — 8mm Super Bold
products.shortDescription: Extra-large 8mm emerald-green cardamom pods bursting with intense menthol-sweet aromatic oils.
products.description: Known worldwide as the Queen of Spices, our Alleppey Green Cardamom is carefully hand-graded to select only the plumpest 8mm pods. Sourced directly from mist-covered valleys near Munnar, each pod retains its vibrant emerald shade and sweet camphoraceous aroma.
ingredients: 100% Whole Alleppey Green Cardamom Pods (Elettaria cardamomum)
products.storageInfo: Keep tightly sealed in an opaque container to preserve the volatile cardamom oil.
products.usageTips: Lightly crush whole pods into chai, fragrant biryani, kheer, payasam, or baking batters.

products.name: Handcrafted Ceylon Roll Cinnamon Quills
products.shortDescription: Delicate multi-layered sweet cinnamon quills with ultra-low coumarin, harvested from coastal ghat forests.
products.description: Unlike rough, hard cassia bark, our true Ceylon cinnamon rolls feature papery-thin layers softly curled by experienced estate artisans. It boasts a gentle, delicate woody sweetness without bitterness, making it ideal for both savory curries and gourmet desserts.
products.storageInfo: Keep in a cool, moisture-free container.
products.usageTips: Simmer whole sticks in aromatic pulao, hot spiced mulled apple cider, or steeped teas.

products.name: High-Eugenol Wayanad Clove Buds
products.shortDescription: Plump reddish-brown clove buds hand-picked before flowering, overflowing with natural eugenol oil.
products.description: Sourced from organic family groves in the heights of Wayanad, our clove buds are dried with their crown crowns intact. When pressed gently, they release a deep, warm aromatic oil that lends immense depth to Kerala curries, biryanis, and herbal concoctions.
products.storageInfo: Store in airtight tins or dark glass containers.
products.usageTips: Stud into onions for stocks, or infuse into chai, garam masala, and slow-braised curries.

products.name: Kerala Red Nut Mace (Javitri) & Nutmeg Combo
products.shortDescription: Brilliant carmine-red lace mace arils with whole shelled nutmeg fruit.
products.description: Directly sourced from organic nutmeg gardens in Kalady and Munnar foothills. Mace is the delicate lace-like lattice surrounding the nutmeg seed, possessing a much more floral, refined and musky warmth than nutmeg alone.
ingredients: Whole Natural Nut Mace (Myristica fragrans aril)
products.storageInfo: Keep tightly sealed away from air and humidity.
products.usageTips: Grind freshly into Mughlai gravies, Dum Biryani, or gourmet béchamel and custards.

products.name: Authentic Kerala Pathimugam (Sappan Wood)
products.shortDescription: Traditional Kerala Ayurvedic pink herbal drinking water wood shaving, cooling and detoxifying.
products.description: Pathimugam (Caesalpinia sappan) is an iconic Kerala tradition. Boiling water infused with these natural wood shavings turns into an elegant rose-pink herbal elixir known for blood purification, digestion ease, and body-cooling properties.
ingredients: 100% Pure Dried Sappan Wood Shavings (Caesalpinia sappan)
products.storageInfo: Store in a dry cloth pouch or airtight jar.
products.usageTips: Boil 1 liter of drinking water with 1/2 teaspoon of Pathimugam shavings for 2-3 minutes. Drink warm or chilled throughout the day.

products.name: Kolukkumalai High-Peak Orthodox Black Tea
products.shortDescription: Single-estate orthodox whole leaf tea harvested from the highest organic tea gardens in the world (7,900 ft).
products.description: Perched in the sky above Munnar, Kolukkumalai produces tea leaves kissed by mountain clouds and crisp morning frost. Crafted using traditional 1930s orthodox rolling methods, this golden liquor presents notes of honey, mountain pine, and muscatel.
ingredients: 100% Orthodox High-Grown Pure Black Tea Leaves (Camellia sinensis)
products.storageInfo: Store in an opaque, airtight canister away from pantry spices.
products.usageTips: Steep 1 teaspoon in 90°C hot water for 3 to 4 minutes. Enjoy pristine without milk, or with a dash of honey and lemon.

products.name: Ripple Tasty Leaf Tea
products.shortDescription: "Blend of CTC leaf, Orthodox whole leaf and high-grown green Oolong tea with rich aroma and refreshing taste.

products.name: Premium Dust Tea
products.shortDescription: Plantation-packed Munnar dust tea selected and blended for a strong, aromatic and refreshing cup.

settings.announcementText: 🌿 transparency shipping across india | Sourced fresh from Munnar & Western Ghats
settings.businessAddress: Kalaivani Spices & Plantation Depot, Post Office Junction, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala - 685612
settings.aboutStory: Founded amidst the mist-clad hills of Munnar and the lush slopes of the Western Ghats, Spice Roots (Kalaivani Spices) connects generational spice planters with kitchens that revere authenticity. Each peppercorn, cardamom pod, and hand-rolled cinnamon quill is selected for peak essential oil content, zero adulteration, and traditional sun-drying practices.
settings.shippingPolicy: Orders are dispatched within 24-48 business hours via trusted courier partners (Blue Dart, DTDC, India Post). Standard delivery timeline is 3-6 business days across India. Tracking details are emailed and accessible on our tracking page as soon as your shipment is picked up.
settings.returnPolicy: Because spices and food products are perishable and consumable goods, we accept returns or replacements within 7 days of delivery only for items received in damaged condition, defective packaging, or incorrect products sent. Please reach out to care@spiceroots.in with photos of the package.
settings.privacyPolicy: We respect your personal privacy. Customer information including address, phone number, and email are solely utilized to fulfill your orders, process payments securely, and send order updates. We never sell, rent, or lease customer data to third-party marketing services.
settings.termsAndConditions: By using Spice Roots, you agree to these terms. Prices are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) inclusive of applicable taxes. Order cancellation is supported prior to dispatch. Products are subject to seasonal availability from our plantation harvests.
